sources.title: Jev-Style-Qwen3.5-2B-Decision (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jev (TypeSafe AI, 2026) introduced System One models: instead of generating text, the model takes a state plus a typed question and returns a decision with calibrated probabilities in a single pass.

sources.title: Jev AI — Decisions at machine speed
sources.snippet: Jev AI is the first System One Model from TypeSafe AI: type-safe decisions in 70-500 ms, zero hallucinations, calibrated confidence. Founded by a ChatGPT co-inventor. Output tokens free, input from $0.042 per million.

sources.title: Jev API & Hub for the Jev Model | Jev AI Community
sources.snippet: Explore Jev API documentation, trending community workflows, and use cases like code compaction powered by TypeSafe AI's first System One Jev Model.

sources.title: Jev by TypeSafe AI — Try the System One model & API
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it turns messy input into typed, calibrated decisions software can use directly — no hallucinations, 70-500ms. Try it free in the browser and learn the API.
